title: Old Town Daly Overlook | KEY.co
description_expanded: Perched just above Historic Main Street, Daly Overlook offers a rare blend of modern style and alpine charm in the heart of Old Town Park City. This freshly updated four-bedroom, four-and-a-half-bathroom retreat spans nearly 2,500 square feet across four levels, with stunning mountain views, natural light, and designer finishes throughout. Enjoy unbeatable access to Park City’s legendary slopes, acclaimed dining, and vibrant festival scene—all just steps away, yet peacefully tucked into a quiet hillside setting. Inside, vaulted ceilings, warm wood floors, and panoramic windows create an inviting living space, complemented by a chef’s kitchen, cozy fireplace, and multiple lounge areas. Each bedroom is thoughtfully appointed for comfort and privacy, including a top-floor suite with its own hot tub deck and views over Old Town. Whether you're carving fresh powder, exploring galleries, or relaxing under the stars, Daly Overlook is your elevated home base for every season in Park City.
